facts.fact: Carson 在周一早上 seven forty-three 说 yes，答应重新举办丰收节。
facts.anchor: I said yes at seven forty-three on Monday morning.

facts.fact: Carson 发出短信后，对方的回复在 twelve seconds later 就到了（Rosie 秒回）。
facts.anchor: The response came twelve seconds later.

facts.fact: Rosie 通知 Carson 十点（at 10）在她家开会。
到 nine thirty，谷仓前出现一张 Carson 自己没摆的折叠桌（镇上人提前布置）。
facts.anchor: By nine thirty, a folding table had appeared in front of the barn that I had not put there.

facts.fact: 九点四十五（nine forty-five），June Whitaker 带着两个面包盒（two bakery boxes）和剪贴板到场。
facts.anchor: At nine forty-five, June Whitaker arrived carrying two bakery boxes, a clipboard, and enough determination to frighten any reasonable person.

facts.fact: 九点五十二（nine fifty-two），Clover 开车赶到，后备箱装满南瓜。
facts.anchor: At nine fifty-two, Clover pulled in behind her with the trunk of her car filled with pumpkins.

facts.fact: Rosie 十点整（exactly ten）挟着三块海报板（three poster boards）到场。
facts.anchor: Rosie arrived at exactly ten with three poster boards tucked beneath one arm.

facts.fact: 到十点十五（ten fifteen），二十三（twenty-three）人站在 Marigold Ranch 前，Carson 数了两遍确认。
facts.anchor: By ten fifteen, twenty-three people stood in front of Marigold Ranch.
